window._optional: Cornice-finestra sopra il menu (i giochi scorrono dietro il telaio). Per tornare al vetro senza finestra: "image": null.
window._measuredFrom: window.webp 1920x1080 (tools/build_finestra.py), apertura interna misurata sulla riga/colonna centrale, in % dai bordi dello schermo.

button._optional: Tile nude di default (icona + titolo). Per la cornice di legno: "image": "assets/tile-button.png" - aspectRatio e contentBox qui sotto sono gia' misurati su quel file.
button._measuredFrom: assets/tile-button.png is 1024x1024, a single pre-composed image (wood frame + board fill in one piece, transparent outside), placed at 100% of the square button area with no scale/crop and no backdrop color behind it: whatever this art does not cover, the tile itself is fully transparent (no background, no border-radius) so the forest background shows straight through, by design. An earlier version tried scaling the image up to hide its own uneven internal margin behind a matching backdrop color - dropped in favor of this simpler, more honest rendering. contentBox is the board's usable inner area, measured directly: top 30%, bottom 30%, left 28%, right 28% from the SQUARE's edges (the square being just the button image area now, not the whole taller tile, since the title moved below it) - conservative on purpose so the logo never touches the wood. Update contentBox if this image changes; the shell derives the logo's slot position from it, so it stays aligned only if measured from the actual file in use.
